name: react-orpc
description: React + oRPC (contract-first, OpenAPI link) + TanStack Query against the purlin blog-api, with typed Server-Sent Events.

scripts.gen: cd ../blog-api && cargo run --quiet -p purlin-cli -- generate contract --also ../../crates/purlin-health/src --out ../react-orpc/src/contract.generated.ts
scripts.check:contract: cd ../blog-api && cargo run --quiet -p purlin-cli -- generate contract --check --strict --also ../../crates/purlin-health/src --out ../react-orpc/src/contract.generated.ts
